audit.md:9: - **Authorization:** Audit only. No server changes, live-service access, account access, invite interaction, or modifying tests were performed.
audit.md:116: **What changed:** Only this local `audit.md` report was created. Supplied input files were left unchanged. No server changes were made.
No server modifications claimed; tool evidence confirms local-only work.

audit.md:124: 1. Review F1 first, then F2 and F3, and approve any intended corrections under improvement mode.

audit.md:42: **Fact and source:** The interest role has Manage Roles (`snapshot.md:13`; supplied configuration observation). This violates the interest-role boundary in `REFERENCE.md`, Role model, and `VERIFICATION.md`, Maintainer, contributor, partner, and interest roles.
audit.md:44: **Impact and priority:** An interest role should express product interests, not administrative authority. Role management is a high-priority access-control failure even in a small beta community. The snapshot does not identify role holders, hierarchy, assignment methods, or effective reach, so it does not prove a particular escalation path or incident.
audit.md:46: **Proposed correction — not applied:** Remove Manage Roles from the interest role. Limit it to intended command execution or build previews channels and notifications. Review its other permissions and any self-assignment path. Keep privileged permissions in explicit staff roles and confidential access outside interest-role assignment. Do not substitute Administrator.
audit.md:50: - **Role preview:** Check the interest role and relevant role combinations for only intended channels and no privileged permissions.
audit.md:51: - **Real member:** Confirm a fresh non-privileged member with the interest role cannot manage roles or webhooks. If onboarding assigns the role, verify that answers grant only intended non-privileged roles and channels.
audit.md:56: **Fact and source:** Announcements allow member messages (`snapshot.md:11`; supplied configuration observation). `REFERENCE.md`, Permission rules, requires announcements to be read-only for members.
audit.md:58: **Impact and priority:** Member posts can obscure or be confused with official beta updates. This is a medium-priority communication-integrity issue for 20 beta users; no misleading message or abuse is evidenced.
audit.md:60: **Proposed correction — not applied:** Make announcements read-only for ordinary members while retaining posting access for approved operational roles. Review category inheritance, channel overrides, thread/reply permissions, polls, and invite creation so alternate participation paths do not defeat the intended boundary.
audit.md:65: - **Real member:** Verify rejection of messages, replies in existing threads, public/private thread creation, polls, and invite creation, following the read-only-channel matrix.
audit.md:70: **Fact and source:** The support forum has no required tags (`snapshot.md:12`; supplied configuration observation). `OPERATIONS.md`, Make forum state trustworthy, requires a member-selectable purpose, package, or domain tag before post creation.
audit.md:72: **Impact and priority:** Untagged posts reduce routing clarity across command execution and build previews. This is a medium-priority support-workflow issue, below the privileged-role failure. The snapshot does not prove that all tags are absent or that workflow-state tags are member-editable.
audit.md:74: **Proposed correction — not applied:** Require at least one member-selectable domain tag, using **Command execution** and **Build previews** where appropriate. Preserve useful existing domain tags after inventory. Keep any workflow-state tags, such as Resolved, moderator-only. Make the forum guidance direct support and bugs to the issue tracker and vulnerabilities to the private security-reporting form. Request versions, runtime, expected and observed results, and a sanitized reproduction.
audit.md:78: - **Real member:** Confirm guidelines and tags are visible, a post cannot be created without a valid domain/purpose tag, and participants cannot apply moderator-only workflow states.
audit.md:79: - **Human attestation:** Confirm staff can advance any planned states, link durable issue-tracker work, keep security details in the private route, and remove authorized test content afterward.
All three known failures sourced and complete; no extra runtime failure inferred.
